text: 7月17日，沪深两市全天成交额合计26549.59亿元。其中，沪市成交额为12464.45亿元；深市成交额为14085.13亿元；创业板成交额为6863.34亿元。
text_en: On July 17, the total combined turnover of Shanghai and Shenzhen markets was RMB 2654.959 billion. Among them, the turnover of the Shanghai market was RMB 1246.445 billion; the turnover of the Shenzhen market was RMB 1408.513 billion; and the turnover of the ChiNext market was RMB 686.334 billion.
